node.title: DLI ell=2 weight-6 relations excluded by recursive norm and the official split gate
node.statement: For every official q<2^256 with v_2(q-1)>=41 and every exact order-1024 root omega in F_q, no reduced signed weight-6 polynomial P satisfies P(omega)=P(omega^3)=0. Odd dilation and rechoosing the normalized root of the selected triple reduce the triple-cubic router to exactly 404,740 candidate orbits. Of these, 404,230 have nonzero Norm(u)-saturated obstruction gcds factoring over 443 recursively Pocklington-certified primes with maximum v_2(p-1)=18. For the 510 identically double-zero candidates, the characteristic-zero power-of-two vanishing-sum lemma forces an antipodal pair, so the reduced guard fails. Hence the residual WCL slot (ell,w)=(2,6) is empty on every official row.
